description: This file defines the Zebra_DatePicker JavaScript plugin, a date picker widget that integrates with jQuery. It includes configuration options, initialization, UI rendering, date parsing, and event handling logic.

classes.name: a.Zebra_DatePicker
classes.description: Main class implementing the date picker widget, handling setup, rendering, user interaction, and destruction.

methods.name: P.clear_date
methods.description: Clears the selected date in the date picker.

methods.name: P.destroy
methods.description: Destroys the date picker instance, removing event handlers and DOM elements.

methods.name: P.update
methods.description: Updates the date picker settings and UI.
